visual_review.method: Compared complete source image with final Mermaid PNG: all visible entity labels, stereotypes, inheritance directions, plain associations and literal end labels reconciled. Verified parallel TimeFrame associations, switch-order/execution leg hierarchies, both tax associations, six labels on the single price/statistics line, account specialization and contextual party-role hierarchy. Printed package labels are preserved in the entity register; absent labels remain absent and the visibly truncated PlacementAgent label is explicitly retained. No numeric multiplicities are printed.
